attempts.prompt:
Architectural photograph of the entrance hall of a concrete art museum. Brutalist minimalist style.
Materials: board-formed exposed concrete with visible form-tie holes, polished terrazzo floor holding a soft reflection, frameless glass balustrade, one pale timber bench.
Lighting: a slit skylight dropping a hard band of daylight that rakes across the concrete wall and reveals its texture, everything else in cool ambient shade.
Straight vertical lines, 24mm perspective, no distortion, eye-level one-point perspective down the length of the hall.
Palette: concrete grey #928D87, light grey #AAA7A3, pale #C7C5C1, mid grey #636261, warm timber #7C6E60, shadow #443E38.
Composition: hall receding to a vanishing point, lit wall on the right, generous empty floor.

Avoid: warped verticals, impossible geometry, fisheye distortion, clutter, blown highlights, recognizable faces, signage text.
attempts.critique: 폼타이 자국이 남은 노출 콘크리트, 슬릿 천창에서 떨어지는 하드한 빛띠, 광택 테라조 바닥의 반사, 목재 벤치 하나까지 레퍼런스의 어휘를 정확히 썼다. 수직선이 완벽히 곧고 1점 투시 소실점도 정확. 감점은 오른쪽 벽의 하이라이트가 일부 날아간 지점.
attempts.fix: 천창 빛띠의 노출을 반 스톱 낮춰 벽면 하이라이트의 질감을 살릴 것.
